999008199.text: ……って考えたんだけど、どうかな？

localizations.en: ...That's what I was thinking. What do you all think?

999008199.text:
魔物がそこまで高い知能を持っているとすれば、
概ね筋は通っていると思う

localizations.en: If we assume the monster possesses such intelligence, your reasoning makes sense.

999008199.text:
団長さんが感じたのは、強い怒りと憎しみ……
石が想いで操る力があるんだとすれば

localizations.en: The director felt intense anger and hatred... If the stones can control others through emotions...

999008199.text:
そう。ツォルンフルクが最初に石に触ったなら、
その想いを他の石にも拡げることができるはず

localizations.en: Right. If Zornfluch was the first to touch the stone, they could spread those feelings to the other stones.

999008199.text: そういや……
ヤツにも石が刺さってたよな？

localizations.en: That thing had a stone embedded in it too, didn't it?

999008199.text:
うん。アルビーナの推論で間違いなさそう。
やるべきことは……

localizations.en: Yes. Alvina's theory seems correct. What we need to do is...

999008199.text: あいつをぶっ倒せばい～んじゃない？

localizations.en: Just beat the stuffing out of it!

999008199.text:
国を挙げても倒すのが難しかった相手だし、
倒すことありきで考えてると、取り逃がすかも

localizations.en: Even the entire nation couldn't defeat it. If we focus too much on fighting, it might slip away.

999008199.text:
つまり、あの石を取り除いて砕きさえすれば、
石の支配は解けるというわけだね

localizations.en: So if we can just remove and destroy that stone, their control over the others will break.

999008199.text:
でも、あんな高い場所を飛んでるのに、
どうやって石だけ砕くのよ？

localizations.en: But how are we supposed to destroy just the stone when it can fly so high up?

999008199.text: ここはやっぱり、ぶん殴って――

localizations.en: Maybe if we punch it really hard—

999008199.text: えっ
それだぁ！　ユミアの銃ならできるよ！

localizations.en: That's it! Yumia's gun could do it!

999008199.text: この石を砕けるくらいの弾丸を作るのよね？

localizations.en: We'll make bullets strong enough to destroy the stone?

999008199.text: どのくらいの強度がいりそうですか？

localizations.en: How strong would they need to be?

999008199.text: ちょっと殴ってみるわね！
あ！　あんまり散らさないでね！？

localizations.en: Ah! Try not to scatter the pieces everywhere!

999008199.text:
できた！　匂い袋に高音発生器。
そしてこの弾丸。これで戦えるよ！

localizations.en: Done! A scent pouch, sonic emitter, and these bullets. We're ready!

999008199.text: 準備は整いました。島へ向かいましょう！

localizations.en: All preparations are complete. Let's head to the island!
